[name="录武官"]面对抢攻，宗师只是撤了一步。槐天裴的拳在挨到宗师手掌边缘时便已势尽。

[name="槐天裴"]（撑拔骨骼的声音）
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_npc_785_1#3$1")]
[name="槐天裴"]呼……
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.3, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=false)]
[delay(time=1.5)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="习武四十余年，我从未见过高山，也未尝一败。", x=650,y=300, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=500,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n拜的第一位师父教了我半年，摆摆手说已经没有东西可教，让我另找名师。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n在那之后，又陆续拜了几位师父，每一位都只教了一年半载就将我逐出师门。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="世上武功门派数以百计，可人无非双手双脚，哪来那么多花招套路。",x=650,y=300, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=500,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="我要练我自己的武功。",x=650,y=300, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=500,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n让拳头更重，脚步更快，眼神更准。" ,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="可是眼前的这个人……",x=650,y=300, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=500,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[charslot(slot = "l", name = "avg_npc_785_1#1$1")]

[name="录武官"]槐天裴重拳直取宗师身侧，封住其身法退路。

citations.quote:
[name="云青萍"]槐先生的武功，看上去又精进了……
大巧不工，大道至简，道理任谁都明白。
可又有几人能做到在这样生死相搏的时刻无为无我，没有招式章法，只有一拳一脚，在最精准的时刻防守、进攻。
他已经将武融进四肢百骸。
三十合过去了，槐天裴依然站立着，他依然没有落败！
他脚下的山岩已经被拳锋脚劲犁出两道深深的沟壑。
可他已无路可进，再出一拳，便是跌坠山崖。
槐天裴依旧没有半分要退却的样子。
[name="麟青砚"]不好……这样下去，那人还是有危险！
可是这样的决斗，还有谁能插手？
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0,g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0,g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[image]
[bgeffect]
[Background(image="63_mini04_mountaintop",screenadapt="coverall")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[Blocker(a=0.3, r=0,g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[playsound(key="$rungeneral")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_243_waaifu_1#7$1",duration=2)]
[Delay(time=2.5)]
[name="槐琥"]阿爸！！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_785_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="槐天裴"]——！
[Dialog]
[charslot]
一声呼喊，还是让搏命战斗的那个男人愣了神。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_785_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="槐天裴"]你是……
[name="槐天裴"]我……
[name="槐天裴"]……我想起来了。
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.5, r=0,g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[playMusic(intro="$loneliness_intro",key="$loneliness_loop", volume=0.6)]
[Subtitle(text="我想起来了。", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="我与一人，还有四十年之约。", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="我交出了那把剑，因为我割舍不下……", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="我想起来了。", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="我还有一个女儿，我还要护她周全……", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="我的名字是……槐天裴。", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
